component.summary: Sirius IDE. The agentic, AI-native code editor.

description.p: Sirius IDE is an agentic, AI-native code editor. It brings your choice of model — Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, OpenAI, and local models via Ollama or LM Studio — into the editor, with agent mode, multi-file edits and tool use. See https://github.com/ArshadSiddiqui/sirius-ide for installation instructions.
